title: Article
description: An article stored within the Knowledge Base.

id.description: The unique identifier for the article.

title.description: The refined title of the article, resulting from the cleanup process.

content.description: The refined content of the article, resulting from the cleanup process.

url.description: The reference URL of the article. Defaults to null if not provided.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the article was last updated. This field is null if the initial submission is still pending review.

updatedBy.description: The email address of the user who last updated the article. This field is null if the initial submission is still pending review.

metadata.description: Additional key-value pairs related to the article.

originalContent.description: The original content of the article prior to the cleanup process.

originalTitle.description: The original title of the article prior to the cleanup process.

queryExamples.description: Examples of customer questions related to the article. Defaults to an empty array if not provided.

additionalInstructions.description: Specific instructions to ensure responses are relevant and address exceptions.

pendingSubmissionId.description: The unique identifier for the submission currently under review for this article. This field is null if there are no pending submissions.

currentVersion.description: The current version label of the article. This field is null if the initial submission is still pending review.

deploymentStatus.description: The current deployment status of the article.

AdditionalInstruction.description: Guidelines and responses to enhance the article.

clarificationInstruction.description: A guideline to improve the article's content.

exampleResponse.description: A sample response applicable if the clarification instruction is followed.

DeploymentStatus.description: The current deployment status of the article.

Metadata.description: A key-value pair providing additional information about the article.

key.description: The key for the metadata entry.

value.description: The value for the metadata entry.
